subtitle: Out Cebu · Cathay Pacific
overview: Fly from Cebu to Shanghai via Hong Kong on Cathay Pacific and travel by private coach with an English-speaking guide. You will cruise West Lake in Hangzhou, taste tea at Meijiawu Tea Culture Village, walk through Wuzhen’s East Gate, then see the Bund, Nanjing Road and Xintiandi in Shanghai. Four nights in 4-star hotels. This is a shopping-visit tour (jade, tea and Chinese medicine shops).
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Feb 19–23 2027 to May 13–17 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous freshwater lake, a UNESCO World Heritage site, explored here on a boat cruise.
placeDesc.Leifeng Tower: A landmark pagoda on the shore of West Lake in Hangzhou, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Culture Village: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou where guests learn about local tea and taste it.
placeDesc.Wuzhen East Gate: The main entrance to Wuzhen, a historic canal water town with old wooden houses and stone bridges.
placeDesc.The Bund: A historic waterfront promenade along the Huangpu River with colonial-era buildings and a skyline view.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: A landmark TV tower in Pudong with its distinctive spheres, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: The City God Temple in Shanghai's old town, surrounded by a busy market area.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known pedestrian shopping street, lined with shops and neon signs.
placeDesc.Starbucks Flagship Store Shanghai: A large Starbucks flagship store in Shanghai, visited as a city-tour stop.
placeDesc.Xintiandi: A Shanghai district of restored stone-gate houses converted into cafes, shops and restaurants.
placeDesc.Shikumen: The traditional Shanghai stone-gate lane-house style, seen in the Xintiandi area.
placeDesc.Huaihai Road: A major Shanghai shopping street where the tour allows free time for shopping.
